title: Team Member - Product Engineering
jobDescription:
Purpose of the Role

Execute project delivery for specific products in the portfolio from the inception till its commercialization and work with the design team from concept generation phase to detailed design phase and Handling IPR related activities for products

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Contribute towards healthy margins for LMW through advisory support on IE to respective BUs

2. Reduce Cost of Production by Design levers (LAMP) - Mechanical

3. Enable R&D and Manufacturing teams to effectively translate hidden customer needs through appropriate Industrial Engineering interventions and recommendations

4. Enable effective cognizance of customer and market feedback on existing products through appropriate process, facility and tooling related recommendations to respective IE and Manufacturing teams

5. Detailed design, design calculation, modelling, Drawings and implementation of the components and subsystems developed for customer special requirements, complaints, suggestions, manufacturing,scm requests

6. Drawing outsourcing to Design house Petrus Team for customer special requirements, complaints, suggestions, manufacturing,scm requests

7. Identifying & implementing Feasibility checking of ideas and Implementing the design modification for cost reduction projects

8. Review the ECR DCR request and implement design changes.

9. Support to electrical team for BOM & Drawing preparation like motors. Control Panel,Operator Panel .. etc

10.Preparation of trial Relevant format for complaints/developments, cost reduction etc.

11.Co ordination for Preparing the prepare FMD for the complaints raised.

12.Prepare and release the standard BOM for prototype machines

13.Prepare and release the Variables and options to create the complete Product BOM with all frozen specifications. during pilot batch and commercialization

14.Prepare and release the Variables and options BOM to export the same into configurator.

15.Prepare and amend the numeric and logic rules in the configurator to ensure correct configuration

16.Co-ordinating with cost accounts for price arrival for new products to arrive COP (Cost of Production ) for Customized product items

17.preparations of design change Documents and Conducting Pre- ECO meeting & ECO implementations for new components / developments.

18.Prepare and release the ECO for the complaints and requests DCR from user departments

19.Amend the machine work orders for the special executions and communicate the same

20.Amend the machine work orders for the requests of Manufacturing and SCM to attain the DRO through BCR mail

21.Prepare and release of E Number kits for performance enhancement, customer specific request, transit damages, alternate items for obsolete components

22.Attending Prepare spare parts clarifications

23.Conduct second source development

24.Make ECIR Amendments

25.Obtain FSI approvals

26.Supplier visit for developments Design change Implementaion

27.Standardizations of components/ C-class items

28.Documents Preparations of Tech Briefs for the Customer service communication

29.Approve Design Checking of the acceptable deviations concession requested

30.Field Visit mills to Customer place to collect VOC (Voice of Customer) for complaints, trial validation, audits

31.Providing Design solution for New Requirements raised thru Pre dispatch MOM Points.

32.Ensure compliance to TQM, ACDE, ISO and EOHS

33.Maintain a strong understanding of intellectual property laws and ensure that the organization's R&D activities are protected.

34.Deal with external organizations, including research institutions, universities, and other related companies, to facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing.

35.Effective Co ordination ,Data Migration for PLM Implementation

36.Communicate research findings and progress to senior members of the team and function

Execute improved technologies used by suppliers, competitors, and customers.

title: DIC - Strategic Sourcing
location: Kamaraj Road, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu , India
jobDescription:
Purpose of the ROLE:

To work closely with key stakeholders in member organizations and in corporate functions to develop effective cost reduction strategies and implementation plans with the goal of achieving significant initial cost reductions, supplanted with year-over-year productivity improvements of 5% in the total cost of goods and services procured while maintaining or improving product quality and vendor service levels

Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

  • Oversee the development and execution of strategies through the strategic sourcing process for specific Category Group of spend areas

  • Serve as primary champion and process leader for the strategic sourcing process for each of the spend areas

  • Measure and Track forecasted vs actual savings for the Category Group of commodities and is responsible for communicating performance against these measures and their potential budgetary impact

  • Responsible for leading strategic sourcing efforts in specific commodity areas as necessary/appropriate.

  • Work actively with key stakeholders such as Engineering and Marketing to ensure purchasing is actively engaged in core business processes

  • Set priorities and performance goals for Core or Lead Buyers, guide strategy development for major commodities, oversee the development of annual strategic sourcing plans which specify how savings goals will be achieved

  • "Oversee the process to select and manage suppliers"

  • Establish and maintain contractual and business relationships with the senior management of key suppliers

  • Achieve small and disadvantaged business sourcing content objectives

  • Work together with senior stakeholders in the business units to ensure savings are built into budgets and the annual operating plan

  • Work with each Core or Lead Buyers to ensure sourcing strategies are implemented and TCO reductions are secured according to forecasts

  • Responsible for breaking down organizational barriers and communicating overall sourcing trends/results for his/her commodities to the Group CPO and business unit purchasing leadership

  • Develop, champion, and ensure implementation of ideas that will optimize LMW’s total cost of ownership for spend categories

  • Remain current with market trends through relationships with Sourcing Managers, suppliers and market experts, and ensure LMW has a process to gain access/familiarity with emerging supplier capabilities

  • Maintain a working knowledge of applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations as well as any internal policies (e.g. code of ethics) or procedures to ensure that the behavior exhibited by the organization is honest, ethical and professional

  • Identify/define sourcing best-practices both within and external to LMW and ensure that those best practices are widely adopted by LMW’s business groups

  • Supervise the Core or Lead Buyers, communicate team progress with the Head - Strategic SCM and senior business unit leadership and ensure clear alignment between team actions and business unit interests

  • Develop performance objectives and conduct annual reviews with all associated Core or Lead Buyers

  • Participate in career planning and development for each Sourcing Manager and assume a mentoring relationship with high-potential sourcing professionals

  • Improve overall sourcing morale by communicating savings opportunities and successes throughout the company for strategic sourcing commodities and will actively champion the elevation of purchasing as a valued and career enhancing experience

title: Team Member - Field Sales - North Zone
location: Bhikaji Cama Palace, New Delhi, Delhi , India
jobDescription:
Purpose of the ROLE:
  • Responsible for conversion of field enquiry as per funnel management. Ensure effectiveness of visits and calls.
  • Understand customer requirements, sell right Products to the customers.
  • To accomplish the targeted Sales for my allocated area.
  • To accomplish the profitability through revenue generation from high value machines & tooled up machines.

Roles & RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Ensure execution of on-field enquiry conversion tasks assigned by funnel manager
  • Responsible for executing the field enquiries by direct interaction with customers for prosecuting existing enquiries in the sales funnel.
  • Visit customers for executing sales tasks as per the schedule given by funnel manager.
  • Required to participate in short daily WIP meetings with Funnel Managers for reviewing tasks executed during the day and discussing tasks scheduled for the next day.
  • Provide exhaustive feedback for the visits made for the day during the daily review with Funnel Managers (even if this means taking the time to explain things that, from your perspective, appear to be self-evident).
  • Must hand over any new enquiry/opportunity identified during the day to the associated funnel manager.
  • Know the product/service they are selling, and are comfortable overcoming objections w.r.t to the business current offers and any newly launched offer.
  • Able to effectively communicate all the elements of the market offers and address the customer objections w.r.t the same.
  • Achieve Sales revenues from the high value machines / tooled up machines as per the target
  • Participate in exhibitions to promote our products to generate enquires and convert Sales orders.
  • Maintains relationships with clients by providing support, information, and guidance; researching and recommending new opportunities; recommending profit and service improvements.

Desired Candidates Profile:

  • Candidates from Machine Tool Industry / Capital Goods Industry with experience in Machine (CNC/VMC/HMC) sales and business development is preferred
  • Candidate having qualification of Bachelor / Diploma in Engineering is preferred
  • Candidate having very good local language is preferred
  • Candidate having very good attitude and communication is preferred

Virtualization

·Microsoft Hyper-V

·Nutanix HCI (Prism Central / Prism Element)

Storage

·SAN Storage

·NAS Storage

·Storage provisioning and performance management

·Disaster Recovery Planning and Testing

jobDescription:
Purpose of the Role:

1] Fund Management

2] Investment Management

3] Handling of liasioning activities with banks / insurance / others

4] Perform payroll process

5] Book keeping and record maintenance

6] Perform accounting and reconciliation

FUND MANAGEMENT

Prepare & Report daily cash flow to DIC / such other authorized persons;

Execute Fund Allocation instructions from DIC / such other authorized persons;

Ensure submission of Cash Flow Statement to DIC monthly;

Keep Physical Cash in safe locker and reconcile with books of account periodically;

Submit Cash Reconciliation statement for all units [including liasion office] to authorized person on demand;

Review and Update Investment Policy;

Analyse Investment Credit Risk & Submit to DIC, the latest news about Invested MF / Banks in which FD has been made;

Create / Renew / Close the Fixed deposit / Mutual funds with DIC APPROVAL;

Maintain and Reconcile all Invested Values with books of account / documents every month;

Compute Income accrued on investment [FD / Mutual Fund / Others];

Bank Account opening, maintaining and closing with DIC & Board approval;

Deposit cheques and monitor cheque return or unrealized instruments long pending with banks;

Identify and Report in-operative bank accounts periodically to DIC

Manage and Renew the Fund and Non-fund based limits within due date and do periodical reconciliation;

Receive and Process request for fund loading into IB cash card through Indian Bank

Identify relevant products introduced by banks and if approved, implement the same at LMW;

Maintain Company's Purchase Credit Credit in Safe Custody & Use them only with DIC approval;

Receive and Reconcile all credit card payments with credit card statement and take action for noted variances;

Arrange Indian / Other Bank's Cash Card with DIC approval to employees and reconcile them periodically with receipt of bills;

Process & Arrange Gratuity settlement from Insurance companies;

Co-ordinate & Arrange Employee's on-board into Group Mediclaim Policy and Applicable Refund;

Co-ordinate with liasion office & Receive Expense / BRS statement periodically;

Receive GST Invoices from Banks / Insurance Companies periodically;

Receive / download bank related statements periodically ;

Receive and Respond the request [or] complaints raised by banks / Insurance companies / Other stakeholders dealing with Treasury sub function;

Co-ordinate and Arrange Forex Currency to meet Business Foreign Travel as per policy with FIC approval;

Collect Quote and negotiate with vendors like forex / service providers like banks about product pricing and obtain approving authorities approval;

Co-ordinate the treasury related "inter" and "intra" functional activities;

PERFORM PAYROLL PROCESS

Verify and Update Employee's bank account in Employee Master;

Monitor Employee's Running Advances and It's Recovery & Reconcile with GL periodically;

Verify and Process Employee full and final settlement including VRS;

Receive & Update in system, the Payroll related deductions handled in Treasury;

Verify & Disburse Salary, Wages, Bonus, Gratuity and other employee related payments with DIC approval;

Verify & Disburse promptly the recovered amount of housing loan, society loan, insurance etc., that are payable to various institutions ;

BOOK KEEPING AND RECORD MAINTENANCE

Maintain all Original FD Receipts in Safe Custody;

Receive & Keep safely Original Sanction Letter / agreements entered with or by LMW in Treasury Function;

Review and "Renew / close with DIC approval" the consultancy / rental / such other agreements handled in Treasury function;

Negotiate better pricing for availed services like forex / LC Issuance / BG commission / e-brc charges etc.;

Maintain treasury related documents, vouchers and bills safely with complete traceability;

Initiate action for record disposal with DIC / FIC approval.

Maintain such other records and confidential information safely and submit to the authorised person on demand;

PERFORM ACCOUNTING AND RECONCILIATION

Receive / Account [or] Ensure accounting of income, bills, vouchers, claims & reimbursements with appropriate approval / policy & Monitor pending compliants, if any;

Verify and Release consultancy payments as per agreements / invoices every month

Apply Receipts and Reconcile periodically all liaison office advances / Travel advances / Salary advances etc.,

Verify and Settle claims and reimbursements as per policy / accorded approval;

Verify and Post Staff Tax Investment details periodically

Perform / Ensure reconciliation of all Bank Accounts [including liasion office]; Investment Account and Other applicable GL codes;

Receive and Submit GST bills & Vouchers to GST Team periodically;

Prepare & Submit Treasury related GL code reconciliation report's to authorized person on demand;

MANAGE AND MAINTAIN STAFF WELFARE FUND [SWF]

Maintain fund related statements and submit to Autorised Person on demand

Receive and Settle eligible claims subject to fund availability and approval;

Co-ordinate with HR for policy revisions / other activities relating to SWF

COMPLY WITH LMW POLICIES AND GUIDELINES / APPLICABLE LAWS

Ensure adherence to Systems, Procedures and Policies that are Published or Informed time to time either in general / Specific to Treasury Function;

Create / Review / Update SOP / Policy in respect of Treasury function;

Renew Legal Entity Identifier Registration Certificate Annually;

Verify and Ensure correctness of Statutory deduction / recovery handled in Treasury Function;

Pay and Account all statutory dues that are handled in Treasury Function within permitted time;

TQM, RCM AND OTHER ACTIVITIES

Ensure and implement TQM concept at Treasury functions;

Co-ordinate and Co-operate with Internal and External audit related matters and respond to audit observations promptly;

Identify process improvements and implement the same

Review and Update process changes in SOP / Work Instruction;

Monitor progress of entire Treasury Activities & send report to DIC / FIC periodically about completion / issues;

Receive and Execute FIC / DIC Instructions

Perform Cheque Printing with approval and keep safely Printed & signed but not issued on the same day

Keep safely unused printed cheques

PREPARE AND SUBMIT MIS REPORTS

Prepare and Submit MIS Reports to FIC / DIC periodically;

title: DIC - Environment, Health & Safety
jobDescription:
Purpose of the ROLE:

To effectively control and reduce the personal accidents and provide safe working environment to all employees for all group companies in accordance and in compliance with statutory requirements and Ensure Continual improvement in work place environment

Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

  • Plan and effectively implement Environmental Health and Safety Management System strategic goals.

  • Organize in association with the concerned departments/ campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure

  • Develop digital EHS management system for monitoring lead and lag indicators performance

  • To support Business Excellence Roadmap.
